careInstructions:
Cotton Twill
Cotton twill is common on lightweight varsity and coach jackets. It is strong but can shrink with very hot water. Wash in cold or warm water on a gentle cycle with mild detergent. Shake the jacket out after washing to cut down wrinkles. Line dry or tumble dry on low. Iron on medium heat if needed.

Do: Close snaps and zippers before washing the jacket.
Do: Wash dark twill jackets separately the first few times.
Do not: Use very hot water or high dryer heat.
Do not: Leave the jacket wet in the machine for hours.
